verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the open spec define a skill as a plain directory holding a `SKILL.md` (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown), with optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ folders. Anthropic publishes it as the Agent Skills open standard for cross-platform portability, and Claude Code says its skills follow that standard across multiple AI tools. Community comments confirm skills are markdown/YAML files on the filesystem, and one developer adapted the anthropics/skills content to run on Gemini. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of a skill running unchanged in another named harness (the Gemini user built their own adaptation), and Claude-specific wrappers like plugin manifests and API-hosted skill_ids are not themselves portable.
